Question: Suppose \(a\) and \(b\) are real numbers. When the polynomial \(x^3 + x^2 + ax + b\) is divided by \(x - 1,\) the remainder is \(4.\) When the polynomial is divided by \(x - 2,\) the remainder is \(6.\) What is \(b - a?\)
